adaptive_research.method: v4-4b8b50e0; training-only allocation; 20% day monitoring withheld from selection; clustered daily lower bound
adaptive_research.underperformer_policy: >=50 eligible training closes and >=7 training UTC days, clipped daily upper bound < -0.05R, training mean >0.05R worse than CTRL; only 4:1 exploration reweight, never disable; monitoring outcomes excluded
adaptive_research.warning: No strategy has demonstrated a reliable tradable edge. Training-only allocations never access monitoring results. Historical monitoring was previously used for allocations, so it is not an untouched final holdout. Selection remains observational, multi-tested and correlated.

market_breadth.note: Observed eligible entries only; no simulated missing dates or proof of independence.

evidence_quality.note: Correlated trades/2-day trends do not prove edge; funding, slippage and margin not actual fills

fixed_horizon_outcomes.exit_policy: first fresh same-venue observed ticker at/after due time; NO stop-loss or take-profit
fixed_horizon_outcomes.exposure_note: Sum of overlapping virtual research notionals; NOT deployable capital or portfolio equity.
fixed_horizon_outcomes.pnl_note: Only fixed-horizon CLOSED outcomes, fee-adjusted; OPEN unrealized P&L deliberately excluded.
fixed_horizon_outcomes.selection_note: Regime/daypart labels frozen at entry, descriptive and correlated. Post-friction scores include frozen stress when present, otherwise a predeclared 0.12% extra-cost legacy haircut. Day-cluster LCB uses clipped day-mean R; positive screening cannot promote an edge.

friction_stress_scenario.assumption: entry bid-ask crossing plus hypothetical impact; not observed fills

limitations: Correlated trades are not independent evidence of edge
Fixed-horizon only; NO stop-loss, take-profit or interim exit; delayed observations excluded from eligible sample
Spot proxies excluded from eligible perpetual sample
No actual order fills, variable funding, spread, slippage or liquidation

live_source_quality.note: Fresh validated public snapshots only. Spot proxies do not count toward perpetual strategy evidence.

observation_heartbeat.note: Only a validated actual-time public quote can attest idle ticks; never fabricates an OPEN/CLOSE.

scheduling_diagnostics.note: GitHub Actions cron is best-effort; late exits remain excluded from evidence
